section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one unnamed study (use Study X) recruiting women from various organizations; after exclusions the final sample comprised 387 emerging adult women aged 18–25. Mean age was 21.64 (SD=1.70) and mean BMI was 21.58 (SD=3.26); BMI category breakdowns are reported and compared to Portuguese norms. Participants provided written consent and completed self-report questionnaires during an authorized ~15-minute break.
